description: This file is a shell script used for testing git merge and cherry-pick operations, specifically focusing on the influence of different diff algorithms on merge output. It sets up a git repository with specific commits and tags, and runs various git commands to test behavior with different diff algorithm configurations.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful execution of given commands.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting the enclosed commands to fail.

methods.name: git
methods.description: Command-line interface for Git operations used within test scripts.

methods.name: cp
methods.description: Copy files within shell commands to set up test scenarios.

methods.name: git add
methods.description: Stages files for commit in Git.

methods.name: git commit
methods.description: Creates a new commit in Git.

methods.name: git tag
methods.description: Creates tags in Git to mark specific commits.

methods.name: git reset
methods.description: Resets the current HEAD to a specified state, used here to revert to previous commits.

methods.name: git merge
methods.description: Performs a merge operation, with options to specify strategy and diff algorithms.

methods.name: git config
methods.description: Configures Git settings, such as diff algorithm preference.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script execution.
